title: Target naturality of the counit–evaluation projection pairing
statement:
Fix the scheme and four coefficient-stage conventions of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes, with the exceptional adjunction supplied as in [fix-prop-adjunctions]. Let $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ and $N\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$. Use the derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], the chosen restricted tensor–Hom adjunction [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions], and the projection isomorphism [fix-prop-projection-formula] with its map specified in [def-exchange-projection]. Put
$$C=Rf_!M,\qquad L_N=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!N),\qquad A_N=Rf_*L_N,\qquad B_N=R\mathcal Hom_Y(C,N).$$
Integral pullback and tensor are completed; field operations use rationalization and common finite coefficient stages. Write $\varepsilon_{L_N}:Lf^*A_N\to L_N$ and $\mu_N:Rf_!Rf^!N\to N$ for the ordinary and exceptional counits, and $P_T:C\otimes^LT\to Rf_!(M\otimes^LLf^*T)$ for projection. Define
$$q_N=\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N}\circ(1_M\otimes\varepsilon_{L_N}):M\otimes^LLf^*A_N\to Rf^!N,$$
$$p_N=\mu_N\circ Rf_!(q_N)\circ P_{A_N}:C\otimes^LA_N\to N,$$
where evaluation is the counit of the chosen left-factor tensor–Hom adjunction [lem-pod-closed-uncurry-laws]. Let also $N'\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,\Lambda)$ and $r:N\to N'$. Define $L_{N'},A_{N'},q_{N'},p_{N'}$ by the same displayed formulas with $N'$ in place of $N$, and put
$$h=R\mathcal Hom_X(M,Rf^!r):L_N\to L_{N'},\qquad a=Rf_*h:A_N\to A_{N'}.$$
Then the following identities hold for these specified maps:
$$\varepsilon_{L_{N'}}\circ Lf^*a=h\circ\varepsilon_{L_N},\qquad \mu_{N'}\circ Rf_!Rf^!r=r\circ\mu_N,$$
$$\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N'}\circ(1_M\otimes h)=Rf^!r\circ\operatorname{ev}_{M,Rf^!N},$$
$$q_{N'}\circ(1_M\otimes Lf^*a)=Rf^!r\circ q_N,$$
$$Rf_!(1_M\otimes Lf^*a)\circ P_{A_N}=P_{A_{N'}}\circ(1_C\otimes a),$$
$$p_{N'}\circ(1_C\otimes a)=r\circ p_N.$$
All identities hold in the actual derived category at the chosen coefficient stage.

proof.text: All objects and arrows already inhabit the full finite-Tor domains by the types of R.pull, R.direct, R.support, R.exceptional and the fixed-input Hom functors in [def-pod-ctf-pairing-maps]. Thus the separate domains_and_bijections theorem is unnecessary for these equations.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Adjunction.counit_naturality directly to R.ordinaryAdjunction at innerMap r and to R.exceptionalAdjunction at r. Since outerMap r is R.direct.map (innerMap r), these are precisely the first two equations. The adjunction data are the constructed restricted adjunctions of [det-thm-sf-ctf-stability-adjunctions]; no construction from a fresh Hom bijection is needed.

proof.text: Evaluation is definitionally (R.tensorAdjunctionX M).counit.app. Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.counit_naturality for this chosen left-factor tensor-Hom adjunction to R.exceptional.map r. Its right-adjoint image is innerMap r, giving the third equation without uncurry laws.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint and following paragraph: the adjunction maps are natural transformations

proof.text: Expand q. Combine the two successive tensor-functor images using Functor.map_comp backwards, substitute the ordinary counit square, expand Functor.map_comp forwards, and apply the evaluation square. Associativity gives the fourth equation.

source.place: Step 1, naturality of the specified Hom-chain maps

proof.text: Use the naturality field of [fix-prop-projection-formula] at the identity first-input arrow and an arbitrary second-input arrow b. At finite coefficients lift b to the full finite-Tor category; at the other three stages use its underlying arrow. Functor.map_id and identity composition reduce this law to raw_projection_naturality. The hom of rawProjectionIso is definitionally rawProjection at each of the four stages. Assemble the raw components into a natural transformation, then compose with R.tensorY.hom and the inverse of the R.pull-whiskered R.tensorX comparison after support. Its naturality square lifts through the faithful full inclusion to the required restricted projection square of [def-pod-ctf-pairing-maps]. Specialize b to outerMap r.

source.place: Step 1, naturality of the specified Hom-chain maps

proof.text: Expand p, substitute the restricted projection square, combine the two support images using Functor.map_comp backwards, substitute the q square, then expand Functor.map_comp and apply exceptional counit naturality. Associativity yields the final pairing equation. Collect the six equations into Naturality.
